harness_findings: A seeded near-threshold state plus recoverAbandonedSessions() settling old unfinished sessions at launch means the craft job can be pushed over the threshold by an UNRELATED settlement: the first craft-completion run read 1271s against a 1140s seed and a ~90s session, with 41s coming from a recovered session. progress >= threshold was true and meaningless. The seed now sets resetSessions and the assertions require exactly one ledger row plus an advance inside clamp(raw-paused,0,raw) for this session.

copy_coverage.result: every category the engine owns is reachable and every category has an entry point, so no copy line is orphaned; 170 of the 180 scenarios reach the 3-message cap, and the ten that do not are the 5-minute sessions, too short for three messages at 150s gaps. The cap assertion also fails if no scenario reaches the cap, so it cannot go vacuous
copy_coverage.finding: focusCompanion and finishingSupport are mutually exclusive: happiness decides which one a user gets, not position in the session. At 25 minutes with happiness >= 40 the halfway band's single firing spends the third slot; below the threshold the band fires twice (it spans 195s, wider than the 150s silence) and also spends it. The last-stretch line therefore only reaches a short-session, low-happiness user, and at night lateNightCare takes the budget outright. The comment at pet_encouragement.dart:390 claims the opposite intent for late night and cannot occur
copy_coverage.not_fixed_reason: the fix is a cadence change and the cadence is the anti-harassment promise; three options with their costs are laid out in the review doc and the owner chooses. The test locks the current coverage so a cadence edit fails loudly and forces the review doc to be re-issued

retracted_findings: RETRACTED 2026-09-22: an earlier claim that craft_dao._mapJob maps status with firstWhere without orElse and therefore throws was wrong. craft_dao.dart:248 has carried 'orElse: () => CraftJobStatus.pending' since before this track (verified with git show HEAD:.../craft_dao.dart) and the file is unmodified. The real cause of the C6 seed not taking effect was a harness bug: the seed wrote status='in_progress' while findActiveJobByUser filters on status.isIn(['pending','inProgress']) (craft_dao.dart:72), so the row was never selected and _mapJob was never called. Seeding the enum's .name (inProgress) fixed it. No owner decision is outstanding here.

Ending a session and leaving the completion page by the bottom tab bar skipped the save, so the user was shown 恭喜获得奖励 +20 XP and then 0 分钟 / 0 次 on the records page until the home page's recovery hook or the next launch settled it. phases.P16_runtime_gate: DONE for idle and transition: sampled 12 time points on the release build and measured pixels rather than trusting one screenshot. Static control region = 0.000 difference (zero noise floor), companion region = 19.87, change confined to the companion and concentrated on outlines, distance-from-first oscillates (a cycle, not a drift). Transition idle->focus moves the pose 24.19 vs 14.66 jitter. Confirmed the path is CompanionSpritePlayer via MochiVisualProvider -> PetAvatarWidget, so this is sprite playback. WALK not run: needs placed furniture and the DB was reset for P14. Also audited sit_down vs reverse(stand_up): dog 0.0021 (is a reverse), rabbit 0.0193 (is a reverse), cat independent; visually reviewed and acceptable, but 'better than an independent version' is unprovable while Flow video is down. See P16_RUNTIME_GATE_AND_TRANSITION_AUDIT.md.
phases.P17_runtime_gate_walk: DONE: RUNTIME_GATE_WALK PASS on the release build. A walk needs placed furniture, so the precondition was seeded directly (pet + pet_progress + rug/sofa owned and placed) rather than waiting 30 focus-minutes to craft one - the seed is a fixture, everything after it is shipping code. Triggered by a sofa player request; 10 frames captured across the travel show a striding in-place gait at the rug, mid-stride, then seated on the sofa. Measured: the rug region drops to exactly 0.00 occupancy from frame 2 while the sofa region keeps content until it settles; and the companion is detectable in the floor band only in the first frame, i.e. standing on the floor and then elevated on the cushion. No double displacement - the sprite stays planted while screen position advances. All three runtime gates (idle/transition/walk) now PASS. See P17_RUNTIME_GATE_WALK.md.
phases.P18_fixture_harness: DONE: raw-SQLite QA seeding replaced by a debug-only fixture harness that seeds through the real repositories (lib/dev/qa_fixture.dart + qa_fixture_main.dart). 7 scenarios; LOW_ENERGY is not expressible because CompanionVitals is in-memory presentation state that never reaches the database. Release unreachability is enforced three ways: a separate entry point, a structural import-scanning guard test, and a kDebugMode throw. Idempotency verified in tests and on device (second launch reports identical counts). Reset removes only qa_-prefixed rows and is proven not to touch production state. video_to_sprite now enforces TEST_VIDEO != PRODUCTION_ART - a test clip is refused without --out-root. Gates: format PASS, analyze PASS, tests 1142/1142, debug APK PASS, git diff --check PASS. See P18_RUNTIME_FIXTURE_AND_FLOW_PIPELINE.md.
phases.P19_architecture_audit: FAIL on the phase gate, honestly. BEHAVIOR_AUTHORITY_COUNT = 2 (gate 1): CompanionBehaviorDirector and FurnitureActionResolver both decide what the companion does and can disagree. Verified independently, not taken from the auditor: room_page.dart:587 passes only the anchor ROLE to CompanionAvatar, so the simulation's chosen actionId never reaches the renderer, while the label names it. No pack ships any room_* action, so room_sit/room_work/room_read/room_sleep resolve through an explicit semanticFallback chain - designed, never blank, but a desk 'craft' shows focus_write art under a 正在做点小东西 label. The other four counts are 1: reward (RewardService, one rate, production always atomic), room truth (roomItems), inventory truth (inventoryItems), growth truth (PetProgress + GrowthLevelCurve). 14 findings classified; 3 need an owner decision, the first being whether 'use furniture' decides the action or only the destination - which must be answered before the two deciders can be merged. No code changed. See P19_ARCHITECTURE_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH_AUDIT.md.
